record.paper_title: Some open problems in dynamical systems
record.original_question: Let Diff^∞_0(T^n) be the group of smooth diffeomorphisms of the torus T^n that are smoothly isotopic to the identity, and let G be the C^∞ closure of the subset of maps with no periodic points. For n ≥ 2, does this closed set G have empty interior in Diff^∞_0(T^n)?

evidence.quote: 5.2 - Question. Does the closed set G have no interior (n≥2) in Diﬀ∞ 0 (Tn) ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n\geq 2$ and let $\mathbb{T}^n=\mathbb{R}^n/\mathbb{Z}^n$ be the $n$-dimensional torus. Denote by $\operatorname{Diff}^\infty_0(\mathbb{T}^n)$ the group of $C^\infty$ diffeomorphisms of $\mathbb{T}^n$ that are smoothly isotopic to the identity, equipped with the $C^\infty$ topology. Let 
$$P=\{f\in\operatorname{Diff}^\infty_0(\mathbb{T}^n): f\text{ has no periodic points}\},$$
and let $G=\overline{P}$ be its closure in $\operatorname{Diff}^\infty_0(\mathbb{T}^n)$. Does $G$ have empty interior in $\operatorname{Diff}^\infty_0(\mathbb{T}^n)$?
artifact.status_search_result: No source directly resolving this question was located. Related recent work (e.g., a $C^\infty$ closing lemma for area-preserving torus diffeomorphisms, and structural results on periodic-point-free torus homeomorphisms) addresses the area-preserving or topological setting but does not appear to settle whether the $C^\infty$ closure of the set of periodic-point-free maps in $\operatorname{Diff}^\infty_0(\mathbb{T}^n)$ has empty interior for $n\geq 2$ in the dissipative smooth category.

status_evidence.title: A C^∞ closing lemma on torus
status_evidence.snippet: For area-preserving diffeomorphisms on T^2 isotopic to the identity, periodic orbits are dense for a generic diffeomorphism.
status_evidence.claim: A C^∞ closing lemma is known in the area-preserving case on T^2, but this does not directly answer the dissipative smooth question.

status_evidence.title: Periodic point free homeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizations of periodic point-free homeomorphisms of the 2-torus in terms of irrational circle rotations as factors.
status_evidence.claim: Recent structural results exist for periodic-point-free torus homeomorphisms, but none located explicitly resolves the empty-interior question in Diff^∞_0(T^n).
